title: Millo Mod 2
description: A utility mod for MCDiamondFire aiming to make me specifically more efficient.
body:
A MCDiamondFire utility mod aimed to make me specifically more efficient at coding on `mcdiamondfire.com`.

Contains some simple features like:
- Code "Editor"
- Mode Switcher
- Lagslayer Overlay
- Waypoints
- No Clip
- Other stuff


Use `/settings` to modify settings :3
